name: StashAway (MENA)
legal_name: StashAway Management (DIFC) Limited (DIFC registration no. CL 3982)
founded: DIFC entity licensed by the DFSA on 28 Oct 2020 and launched in late 2020; the StashAway group was founded in Singapore (operating since 2017).
ownership_summary: DIFC subsidiary of the privately held, venture-backed StashAway group headquartered in Singapore (the group's MAS-licensed entity is Asia Wealth Platform Pte Ltd). The DIFC entity's immediate shareholder is not named in sources opened. Group investors shown on the website include Square Peg, Sequoia (now Peak XV), Hamilton Lane, Fidelity International (Eight Roads) and Asia Capital and Advisors; the group says USD 86.5m has been invested in it, including USD 12.5m raised in Jan 2025 from existing institutional investors and a new family office. Stakes are not disclosed.

government_link: None found for the MENA entity. At group level a board seat is held by a director from NTUC Income & Singapore Labour Foundation (Singapore labour-movement linked); no Gulf government shareholder found (checked 2026-10-12).
group_structure: StashAway group (Singapore HQ) operates in Singapore, Malaysia, Hong Kong, Thailand and the UAE. The Singapore entity Asia Wealth Platform Pte Ltd holds an MAS Capital Markets Services licence for retail fund management (CMS100604, per help-centre search snippet). The MENA business is StashAway Management (DIFC) Limited, DFSA firm F006312, licensed 28 Oct 2020 with Retail Client and client-assets endorsements for Advising on Financial Products, Arranging Custody, Arranging Deals in Investments and Managing Assets. Group leadership (CEO, CIO, CTO, compliance) is shared across markets; the UAE has a Country Manager.
footprint: UAE (DIFC office: Office 611, Level 6, Liberty House, Dubai), serving UAE and wider MENA clients from the DIFC. Group markets: Singapore, Malaysia, Hong Kong, Thailand, UAE. MENA business active as of Oct 2026: new DFSA-registered SEO effective 10 Aug 2026, UAE product launches in Sep and Dec 2025, live website. Checked 2026-10-12.
customer_segments: UAE retail and mass-affluent investors (no minimum for managed portfolios); HNW via StashAway Reserve (USD 100k+ for a dedicated wealth advisor, launched in UAE Sep 2024); Professional Clients for private markets (from USD 20k). Company says the affluent segment drove over 75% of its UAE growth in the year to Dec 2025.
business_lines: Automated managed ETF portfolios (General Investing, Responsible/ESG, Thematic, Flexible), Shariah Global Portfolio (Sep 2025), cash management (StashAway Simple in AED/USD; USD Cash Yield), StashAway Reserve HNW advisory (Sep 2024), private markets for Professional Clients (private credit, private equity and private infrastructure portfolios with Hamilton Lane), Unicorn Top 20 (listed in site navigation).

capabilities.wealth_summary: StashAway MENA is the DIFC arm of Singapore's StashAway, licensed by the DFSA since Oct 2020 for managing assets, advising, arranging deals and arranging custody with a retail endorsement, and still active in 2026 (new SEO registered Aug 2026). It runs automated ETF portfolios (General Investing, ESG, Thematic, Flexible) from a 0.2% p.a. fee with no minimum, plus a Shariah Global Portfolio launched Sep 2025 (four risk levels; Shariah ETFs, sukuk, gold; 0.2–0.8% fee). Cash products are StashAway Simple (AED/USD) and USD Cash Yield. StashAway Reserve (UAE launch Sep 2024) gives clients with USD 100k+ a dedicated wealth advisor. Professional Clients can invest from USD 20k in private credit, private equity and private infrastructure portfolios managed with Hamilton Lane (PE and infrastructure added Dec 2025). Assets sit with Saxo as custodian and Emirates NBD as trustee bank; UAE AUM and client numbers are not disclosed.

private_banking.detail: Not a bank. Closest offer is StashAway Reserve (dedicated wealth advisor, financial planning, portfolio reviews for USD 100k+), positioned against private banks.

asset_management.detail: DFSA permission 'Managing Assets' (licensed 28 Oct 2020). Portfolios built in-house by the group investment team (CIO Stephanie Leung) using the ERAA regime-based allocation; ETF-only for public portfolios. MENA AUM not disclosed.

brokerage.detail: No self-directed trading found on stashaway.ae; DFSA permission covers arranging deals for managed portfolios. Group 'ETF platform' (since 2025, per Hubbis) not evidenced for the UAE.

digital_investing.detail: StashAway app and web platform for UAE residents; recurring investments via Lean integration (2025).

advisory.detail: DFSA permission 'Advising on Financial Products'. Human advice through Reserve Wealth Advisors (USD 100k+); automated goal-based advice in the app.

discretionary.detail: Managed portfolios are professionally managed and dynamically re-optimised by StashAway's investment team.

model_portfolios_robo.detail: Robo portfolios across General Investing, Responsible (ESG), Thematic, Flexible and Shariah Global (four risk levels), using ETFs from issuers such as BlackRock/iShares, JPMorgan, Vanguard and Invesco.

funds_platform.detail: No open third-party mutual fund shelf; third-party ETFs and private-market funds are used inside StashAway portfolios.

private_markets.detail: For Professional Clients from USD 20k: private credit (Hamilton Lane, UAE since Sep 2024), and semi-liquid Private Equity and Private Infrastructure portfolios managed by Hamilton Lane (Dec 2025; fee as low as 0.5%; no multi-year lock-up). 'Unicorn Top 20' pre-IPO product listed in navigation; group also launched a hedge fund for accredited investors (since 2025), UAE availability unclear.

islamic_wealth.detail: Shariah Global Portfolio launched in the UAE Sep 2025: four risk levels, Shariah-compliant ETFs (global equities, sukuk, gold), 0.2–0.8% fee, no minimum. Compliance relies on issuer certification; StashAway does not certify it. No DFSA Islamic Window endorsement found.
